'''Vestin Axlon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]], who rose to become [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Logarra District]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. After Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]], he became a leader in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
